shared_elements: quadruped animals shown in profile facing right
human or anthropomorphic figures with animals
low relief carving of animals with rendered surface detail
justification: Both show quadrupeds in profile arranged along horizontal registers with accompanying anthropomorphic figures, and both include a horned ram-like head, which is the most specific overlap. But A is a schematic, flattened composition of stacked, heterogeneous creatures (crouching feline-like beast, small figures, bird-like head, plant/comb motifs) with no coherent scene, whereas B is a naturalistically proportioned procession of two fleecy rams led by robed human attendants with rendered garments, hair and hooves — different conventions and a different narrative logic.
